(Reso Scaffold)
16 Prospect Place, Boronia VIC 3155

Full Time Architectural Draftsperson
$95,000 + superannuation

Summary
Smart Hill Construction Pty Ltd, trading as Reso Scaffold, is a growing construction company specialising in residential, commercial and industrial building projects. As the business continues to expand its design-and-construct capability, the company requires an experienced Architectural Draftsperson to prepare detailed architectural documentation, support project planning and coordinate technical drawings throughout the construction process.

Our Architectural Draftsperson will be responsible for preparing architectural drawings and construction documentation, interpreting design concepts, coordinating technical information and supporting the delivery of residential and commercial construction projects. The position provides specialised drafting support across the business and contributes to efficient project delivery, design coordination and regulatory compliance.

Duties and Responsibilities

Design Documentation and Drafting
•	Prepare architectural drawings, plans, elevations, sections and detailed construction documentation using CAD, Revit and BIM software
•	Translate architectural concepts, sketches and design specifications into accurate technical drawings for construction purposes
•	Revise and update drawings to reflect design changes, engineering requirements and client variations throughout project deliver

Project Documentation and Coordination
•	Prepare documentation required for planning approvals, building permits and construction documentation packages
•	Coordinate architectural drawings with structural, civil, mechanical and other consultant documentation to minimise design conflicts
•	Maintain project drawing registers, revision histories and document control throughout each stage of construction

Technical Design Support
•	Interpret building codes, Australian Standards and planning requirements when preparing architectural documentation
•	Assist with material selections, construction detailing and specification preparation to support project outcomes
•	Produce 3D models, presentation drawings and visual representations where required to assist project coordination and client communication

Stakeholder Liaison
•	Liaise with Architects, engineers, project managers, consultants and clients to clarify design requirements and technical information
•	Coordinate drawing revisions and technical documentation arising from project meetings and consultant feedback
•	Support communication between design and construction teams to facilitate efficient project delivery

Quality Assurance and Compliance
•	Review drawings to ensure accuracy, completeness and compliance with project specifications and applicable regulations
•	Maintain drawing standards, templates and documentation procedures in accordance with company quality systems
•	Assist in resolving design documentation issues during construction and support continuous improvement of drafting processes

Assessment Criteria
•	A relevant qualification in Architectural Drafting, Building Design, Architectural Technology, Architectural Interior Design or a closely related discipline, or relevant industry experience
•	At least three years of relevant experience preparing architectural drawings and construction documentation for residential and/or commercial building projects
•	Demonstrated proficiency using computer-aided drafting software such as AutoCAD, Revit or other comparable CAD/BIM platforms
•	Experience preparing and revising floor plans, elevations, sections, construction details and other technical documentation
•	Ability to interpret architectural concepts, engineering drawings and technical specifications and translate them into accurate construction documentation
•	Ability to communicate and coordinate drawings with architects, engineers, consultants and construction personnel throughout project delivery
•	Understanding of construction methods, building materials and document control procedures
•	Experience managing drawing revisions, version control and project documentation
•	Strong attention to detail with the ability to produce accurate and high-quality technical drawings
•	Well-developed communication and organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines
•	Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with all levels of stakeholders


How to apply:

Applications open on 13 July 2026 and close on 12 August 2026 

Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.

About Us
Monte Construction PTY LTD is an Australian structural steel construction company dedicated to delivering high-quality steel fabrication and construction solutions across commercial, industrial, and infrastructure sectors. With a team of experienced engineers, detailers, and fabricators, Monte Construction specialises in the design, detailing, fabrication, and erection of structural steelwork for a diverse range of projects — from multi-storey commercial buildings and industrial facilities to bridges and civil structures. 

About the role
The Structural Steel Detailer transforms architectural and engineering plans into precise 3D models and 2D shop drawings. This role ensures all steelwork is detailed accurately for fabrication and erection. The position requires strict adherence to Australian Standards and project specifications. The successful candidate will bridge the gap between structural design and practical fabrication.

Duties and Responsibilities

•	Generate detailed fabrication drawings, erection plans, and assembly drawings.
•	Produce accurate Bill of Materials (BOM), cutting lists, and bolt lists for procurement.
•	Identify and resolve design clashes before fabrication commences.
•	Draft and submit Requests for Information (RFIs) to engineers or architects to resolve design discrepancies.
•	Liaise with the workshop to resolve fabrication queries and optimize detailing for manufacturing efficiency.
•	Work with site supervisors to ensure erection plans are clear and practical.
•	Ensure all detailing complies with the National Construction Code (NCC) and relevant Australian Standards.
•	Update models and drawings promptly to reflect design changes and site variations.
•	Maintain accurate records of drawing issues, revisions, and transmittals.
•	Self-check all drawings for dimensional accuracy and completeness prior to formal review.

Essential Skills

•	Comprehensive knowledge of AS 4100 (Steel structures), AS/NZS 1554 (Structural steel welding), and AS 5131 (Structural steelwork fabrication and erection).
•	High level of accuracy in drafting and mathematical calculations.
•	Ability to visualize complex 3D structures from 2D architectural and engineering plans.
•	Proven ability to manage multiple project deadlines simultaneously.
•	Clear written and verbal communication skills for technical coordination.
•	Proactive approach to identifying design flaws and proposing practical solutions.

CQ Sawmilling Pty Ltd, established on 1st March 2022, has taken over the family business of S.T. Olive &

Sons. With a legacy of approximately 50 years in Dingo, S.T. Olive & Sons have specialized in supplying timber for both underground and open-cut mining industries and structural hardwood to the wholesale and retail sector. The sawmill has a history of providing “Link n Lock” roofing timber props and other specialized mining timbers to mines in Central Queensland—a service that CQ Sawmilling Pty Ltd intends to continue offering.

We recognise the importance of environmental commitments and will adhere to all relevant environmental laws. We strive to minimise the business's impact on the environment and will take all necessary measures to ensure compliance with environmental authority conditions. Our goal is to generate very little waste at the mills, and any waste produced will be treated appropriately before disposal. Most timber by-products, such as sawdust, woodchips, firewood, and side flitches, are sold to garden suppliers or the general public.

We are seeking an experienced and qualified Quality Assurance Officer to join and bring their expertise to our dedicated professional team in Dingo QLD.

The Role
As a QA Officer, you are responsible for ensuring that all products and services consistently meet established quality standards and regulatory requirements. This involves conducting audits, performing tests, and driving process improvements. You will oversee production activities, maintain and manage documentation, investigate non-conformities, and implement corrective actions to uphold compliance with industry standards

Your Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Conduct routine audits, inspections, and compliance checks on production lines and raw materials to ensure adherence to safety and quality standards
Ensure compliance with industry standards by confirming that the mill’s Visual Stress Grading practices are applied in accordance with the Australian Standard AS 2082 for forest hardwood
Responsible for verifying timber specifications prior to treatment
Ensure that wood preservative treatment solution meets concentration level and retention period as in Australian Standard AS1604 during the production process
Create quality measurements to track improvement in products
Maintain, review, and update quality documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), batch records, and, in some cases, product specifications
Investigate product quality issues, identify root causes, and prepare reports on non-conforming materials or processes
Manage dispatch requirements and ensure products meet customer expectations and demand
Recommend and implement corrective and preventive actions to enhance product quality and operational efficiency
Work closely with the development team to improve existing products
Ensure testing equipment is properly maintained, calibrated, and used according to protocols
Conduct audits of vendors and suppliers to ensure supplied materials meet company standards
Document quality assurance activities and create audit reports.

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Previous work experience in quality assurance or a similar field
Working knowledge of tools, methods, and concepts of quality assurance
Solid knowledge of relevant regulatory standards
Good communication skills, both verbal and written
Excellent data collection and analysis skills
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills, with high attention to detail

If you have the skills required for this role and you feel this is the job for you, then apply now!
Salary: $92,000 per annum + Super

SK tes is a global leader in sustainable technology lifecycle services, providing end-to-end IT asset management solutions spanning deployment, decommissioning, reuse and recycling. Operating 40+ owned facilities across more than 20 countries and supporting clients worldwide, SK tes processes and managing large-scale technology assets with a strong focus on security, compliance, and value recovery. Guided by its mission to “securely, safely, and sustainably transform and re-purpose one billion kilograms of assets by 2030,” the organisation leverages innovation and global capability to deliver meaningful outcomes for both clients and the environment.

About the Role

Company: SK tes Pty Ltd
Location: Union Cct YATALA QLD 4207
Job Type: Casual 
Salary/Rate: Award Rates Apply (Paid in accordance with the relevant Modern Award)

Role Overview

An IT Recycle Operator is responsible for the proper disposal and recycling of information technology (IT) equipment that has reached the end of its useful life. The role involves handling electronic waste (e-waste) in an environmentally responsible manner, ensuring compliance with regulations, and promoting sustainable practices. The IT Recycle Operator plays a crucial role in reducing the environmental impact of discarded IT assets and supporting the organization's commitment to responsible recycling. 

An operator will work across a multitude of departments in our production facilities. Operators will be efficient and reliable in processing, organising and packing of assets. 

Where an operator has the necessary licences, training and ability, an operator may be required to operate machinery as directed by their line manager.

Key Accountabilities

•	Be responsible for the quality assurance of their own work.
•	Works under routine supervision, either individually or in a team environment.
•	Being able to lift to 15kg.
•	Complete necessary training materials, a directed by the business.
•	Follow all reasonable directions of the Team Leader.
•	Maintain accurate records and inventory of all disposed assets.
•	Some of the daily work activities include receiving, sorting, testing, warehousing, data destruction, and de-manufacturing.
•	General tasks associated with the receiving and dispatch of assets.
•	Able to maintain records or reports in accordance with company procedures.
•	Operators will rotate and work across a multitude of departments in our production facilities and be efficient and reliable in processing, organising and packing of assets.
•	Perform data sanitization and secure data destruction processes on all retired IT assets to prevent data breaches and ensure compliance with data protection regulations.
•	Safely and responsibly handle the dismantling and disposal of electronic components following proper procedures.
•	Conduct accurate testing and assessment of returned assets to determine their potential for refurbishment or reuse as per the guidelines.
•	Conduct Inventory Stock Take activities.
•	May be directed to perform other duties consistent with training and skill levels required for this position.
•	Maintaining confidentiality and ensuring data security throughout the ITAD process.

Job Requirements & Qualifications

•	Experience in Warehousing (Preferable)

•	Effective communication skills
•	Basic admin/data entry capability
•	Understanding of IT hardware components and familiarity with various types of electronic devices.
•	Physical fitness to handle and move electronic equipment.
•	Ability to operate recycling machinery and equipment safely and efficiently.
•	Strong attention to detail to ensure proper sorting and disposal of e-waste.

What We Offer

•	Career progression opportunities
•	Ongoing training and professional development
•	Supportive and collaborative team environment
•	Opportunity to be part of a growing global organisation focused on sustainability and innovation

?? Employment Type: Full Time, Permanent or Casual

**$5,000 is on offer for Trade Qualified Metal Fabricators to join our team** conditions apply


There has never been a better time to join Bowhill Engineering!!!  We are building our team for the T2D Torrens to Darlington project and there are numerous positions available!


Do you have a solid work ethic, great attitude, and a desire to be part of an award-winning team? Bowhill Engineering is seeking motivated and skilled Metal Fabricators to join our high-performing crew. If you’re looking for a career that offers job security, real growth, and the chance to build infrastructure that shapes Australia’s future—this is your opportunity.
 
?? Role Purpose
As a Metal Fabricator/Welder at Bowhill Engineering, you’ll play a key role in delivering precision-fabricated, heavy structural steel components for some of the nation’s most important infrastructure projects. Working in our multiple workshops, you’ll bring your technical expertise, pride in workmanship, and team spirit to every task. Whether you're welding, fabricating, or working to detailed plans, your contribution helps drive project success and uphold Bowhill’s reputation for quality.
 
?? Key Responsibilities
• Fabrication & Welding: Interpret engineering drawings and weld heavy structural components to spec.
• Quality Focus: Maintain high standards of workmanship and complete weld qualifications where required.
• Teamwork: Collaborate with production team, apprentices, and project leaders to get the job done right.
 
?? What Does Great Look Like?
Success in this role means showing up with a can-do attitude, working efficiently and safely, and being proud of the work you produce. A high-performing Metal Fabricator at Bowhill:
? Delivers high-quality welds and accurate fabrication
? Works well under pressure and adapts to varying project demands
? Upholds safety, quality, and productivity standards
? Supports their teammates and contributes to a positive culture
? Seeks improvement and development in their trade
 
? What You’ll Bring
• Trade Qualification minimum 2 years preferred (Cert III in Engineering – Fabrication/Welding or equivalent) or relevant welding experience 
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
• Ability to interpret technical drawings and specifications
• Fit-for-work attitude and high personal standards
• Team spirit and accountability for your own work and results
 
?? Why Work With Us?
At Bowhill Engineering, we don’t just build structures—we build futures. You’ll be part of a company that invests in cutting-edge facilities, meaningful projects, and the people who make them happen. We take pride in our culture and work hard to ensure every team member feels supported and valued.
 
?? Employee Benefits – Why Bowhill?
As a major employer in the Murraylands, Bowhill Engineering offers a comprehensive Employee Value Proposition, including:
• Relocation Incentive / Accommodation Assistance available *(conditions apply)
• Employee Assistance & Health Support Programs
• Reward & Recognition Initiatives
• Social Events & Team Activities
• Career Development & Training Opportunities
• Modern Workshop Facilities with Annual Wage Reviews
 
?? How to Apply
?? Contact: Samantha Krollig, HR Manager – 08 8570 4208
?? Apply via the Bowhill Engineering website – job vacancies page. Resume & 3 x References required.
??? Weld Test required as part of the interview process.
** Applies to Trade Qualified Metal Fabricators only, AU residents only, not applicable Visa sponsored employees, or where other *recruitment incentives or allowances have been applied, at Bowhill Engineering discretion.
